title: Chop a felled log into wooden blocks

title: Craft Campfire

title: Place your first campfire
how: Craft the Campfire from 6 sticks and 3 stones. Use its placement action to set it on reasonably level ground. This goal requires a placed fire, not merely carrying a kit.

title: Light a fire
how: Craft a Campfire (6 sticks, 3 stones), place it, open its fuel storage with F, add sticks and press E near it to light it.

title: Obtain hardwood logs

title: Split your first firewood
how: First chop a felled log into wooden blocks with an axe. Place your Chopping Block, hold the axe, and use the block to split firewood. Note for reviewers: the separate chopping recipe currently consumes an oak log, while the direct station interaction consumes wooden blocks. Resolve both paths and emit one consistent goal-completion event for firewood production.

title: Grow your fire into a medium campfire
how: Make or obtain at least 3 pieces of firewood. Open the existing fire's storage with F and add all three pieces. The lit fire should reach medium (tier 2). Wet wood may delay its effective size.

title: Grow your fire into a large bonfire
how: Fell more trees and add at least 3 whole logs to the lit fire through its fuel storage. Ensure no cooking pot is hanging over the fire, since a pot caps its size at medium. Confirm it grows to the large bonfire (tier 3).
